title: Notification center
desc: Push events such as DDNS changes, certificate expiry, WAF blocks and process failures to channels like Telegram, email and WeCom
noChannels: No channels yet. Add one to receive notifications
confirmDeleteChannel: Delete this channel? Rules referencing it will no longer push to it
noRules: No rules yet. Add a rule to choose which events are pushed to which channels
headersPlaceholder: One per line, in the format Key: Value
fromPlaceholder: Leave empty to use the username
signHelp: Fill in when the bot has "signing" enabled; otherwise leave empty
eventsPlaceholder: Select events; wildcards such as ddns.* are also accepted
silenceHelp: Events of the same type from the same source are pushed only once within this period; 0 disables deduplication
secretSet: Already set; leave empty to keep it
